summary: Learn AI for Project Management with practical PMO automation, dashboards, and reporting workflows. Enroll to improve control and speed.
lede: PMO automation with AI uses generative tools and workflows to reduce repetitive reporting and coordination work. For project managers, PMO analysts, and project controls teams, this course covers checking project data, designing prompts for project documents, automating status reports, and organizing risk and issue information for dashboards, with human review and governance checkpoints built into the process.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with project data, delivery governance, or PMO reporting and now need to apply AI in practical project settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working familiarity with project lifecycle phases, common PMO documents, and basic reporting terminology. Prior experience with project schedules, RAID logs, status reports, or portfolio dashboards will help you move faster through the applied exercises. No programming is required for completion, but comfort using spreadsheet-based project data, digital collaboration tools, and AI assistants will be useful. The course is suitable for intermediate professionals who want to improve project controls, automate routine PMO tasks, and build stronger reporting workflows.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
